name: The Spirealm
description: Jiu Shi’s skills are pushed to the edge as he faces life-or-death challenges inside a brutal VR maze.

videos.title: Snow Village (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi, a VR game designer, unexpectedly receives a beta disc for a "Spirit Realm", an underground new game. After an accident, he finds himself in a corridor with twelve iron doors.

videos.title: Snow Village (2)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi learns more about the snowy world and the mysterious injured person.

videos.title: Snow Village (3)
videos.overview: The group visit the village carpenter and are instructed to head up the mountain to collect logs for a coffin.

videos.title: Snow Village (4)
videos.overview: Ruan Baijie and Ling Jiushi start to unravel the rules of the snowy world.

videos.title: Snow Village (5)
videos.overview: Only four players remain in the snow village as plans are made and the coffin is completed.

videos.title: Snow Village (6)
videos.overview: Ruan Baijie and Ling Jiushi piece together the mystery at the heart of the village.

videos.title: Snow Village (7)
videos.overview: After escaping the snow village, Lin Jiushi meets up with Ruan Baijie.

videos.title: Fitcher's Bird (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi sees past players die from accidents, realizing he cannot refuse the doors. He is transported to a 1985 elevator room for the challenge.

videos.title: Fitcher's Bird (2)
videos.overview: Players receive eggs at a birthday party for triplets. The eggs are the door’s taboo condition, and accidents occur that night.

videos.title: Fitcher's Bird (3)
videos.overview: Zeng Ruguo goes mad and attacks Shen Yixian; the egg breaks, triggering death. Ling Jiushi experiences hallucinations confirming the taboo condition.

videos.title: Fitcher's Bird (4)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi discovers the true nature of the eggs. After surviving an attack, he uncovers the identity of a boy in his hallucinations.

videos.title: Fitcher's Bird (5)
videos.overview: Moved by Ruan Lanzhu’s trust, Ling Jiushi joins Black Obsidian. Birthday party chaos reveals three overlapping timelines and a mission to change fate.

videos.title: Fitcher's Bird (6)
videos.overview: The group uses a time machine to prevent Shen Yixian’s mother from being killed, and the key appears.

videos.title: Sister Drum (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi moves into Black Obsidian Villa, learning the difficulty rises with each door. The next clue is the human-skin drum.

videos.title: Sister Drum (2)
videos.overview: New player Xu Jin joins, and Ling Jiushi navigates a creepy exhibit with Meng Yu and Ruan Lanzhu.

videos.title: Sister Drum (3)
videos.overview: Inside the exhibit, a mural tells of a sister searching for her sibling. Needle rain kills disobedient players, and the day ends back at the base.

videos.title: Sister Drum (4)
videos.overview: In a tower, Ling Jiushi is trapped in a painful hallucination. Ruan Lanzhu finds a notebook, and blood footprints appear overnight.

videos.title: Sister Drum (5)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi solves a riddle from an old woman and suspects the bride-costumed monster on the roof is the missing sister.

videos.title: Sister Drum (6)
videos.overview: Xu Jin reveals her true form and uses drum-induced illusions. Ling Jiushi is saved by Ruan Lanzhu.

videos.title: Sister Drum (7)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi uses drum sounds to scare Xu Jin away, the key appears, and the monster is captured on the exhibit roof. A new player arrives.

videos.title: Satchan (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu enter the Satchan gate, realizing a series of hidden deaths in the school.

videos.title: Satchan (2)
videos.overview: Tan Zaozao is revealed as a celebrity and the team receives new clues to the Satchan gate.

videos.title: Satchan (3)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi confronts X Organization’s fake leader and discovers secret hard drives.

videos.title: Satchan (4)
videos.overview: The team navigates a high school gate, uncovering cursed award certificates and hidden student records.

videos.title: Satchan (5)
videos.overview: Following a blood-written song, the team investigates a series of student accidents tied to Sazi.

videos.title: Satchan (6)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi discovers deadly clues in the school and bloodied walls, revealing dark intentions.

videos.title: Satchan (7)
videos.overview: The team deciphers a spiritual clue in the archives, racing to uncover Satchan’s story before the semester ends.

videos.title: Satchan (8)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi experiences Satchan's torment, prompting the team to investigate bullying and curses.

videos.title: Satchan (9)
videos.overview: Satchan's death sparks mysterious retaliations, revealing the true instigator behind the class’s misdeeds.

videos.title: Satchan (10)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi uncovers the truth behind Satchan's photo and classmates’ deaths, finding a clue to the key.

videos.title: Satchan (11)
videos.overview: The tragic story of Satchan is revealed, and deception within the group triggers deep anger.

videos.title: Sanatorium (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi assesses players’ mental states, teaming with Ruan Lanzhu to survive the first gate.

videos.title: Sanatorium (2)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi and friends prepare for the third gate, with rival groups maneuvering for advantage.

videos.title: Sanatorium (3)
videos.overview: Tan Zaozao enters the third gate, while Ling Jiushi saves a teammate from a deadly trap.

videos.title: Sanatorium (4)
videos.overview: Manipulation and hidden attacks threaten the team, who focus on a morgue to uncover critical clues.

videos.title: Sanatorium (5)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi tracks the vengeful nurse, using strategic observation to prevent further deaths.

videos.title: Sanatorium (6)
videos.overview: Ruan Lanzhu discovers the key tool, following a suspicious figure to reveal the director’s plot.

videos.title: Sanatorium (7)
videos.overview: A doll is secured in Obsidian as Ling Jiushi is recognized as a promising player, while others’ mental states falter.

videos.title: Obsidian
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu commit to finishing the game while avoiding X Organization’s traps.

videos.title: Woman of the Rain (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi enters the Woman of the Rain gate, uncovering unusual paintings and the mysterious presence of the female owner.

videos.title: Woman of the Rain (2)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi discovers the stakes in the painting world as illusions blur reality, exposing a fake Tan Zaozao.

videos.title: Woman of the Rain (3)
videos.overview: Clues hidden in paintings lead the team to uncover possible plagiarism and protect their positions in the game.

videos.title: Woman of the Rain (4)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi rescues a trapped friend from a painting, uncovering betrayals within the group.

videos.title: Woman of the Rain (5)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi narrowly escapes the female antagonist after grabbing the key, waking up in Obsidian Villa.

videos.title: Woman of the Rain (6)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi learns Ruan Lanzhu risked everything for him, uncovering matching scars and deeper mysteries.

videos.title: Night Crying Baby (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi witnesses a festival as part of the Night Crying Baby Gate, with hidden dangers lurking within.

videos.title: Night Crying Baby (2)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi learns the festival is a trap as he enters the Night Crying Baby Gate, protected by Li Dongyuan.

videos.title: Night Crying Baby (3)
videos.overview: A murderous intruder and sinister rituals reveal the grim truth of the manor and the missing children.

videos.title: Night Crying Baby (4)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi discovers children’s memorials hiding dark secrets, uncovering the abuse behind the Night Crying Baby Gate.

videos.title: Night Crying Baby (5)
videos.overview: The team uncovers clues in a university-like room, avoiding a trap set by Yan Shihe while identifying the oil thief.

videos.title: Night Crying Baby (6)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi investigates a hallucinatory plot caused by tainted oil, revealing the true dangers of the Night Cry Gate.

videos.title: Night Crying Baby (7)
videos.overview: A tense reunion triggers a hidden game clue, as Li Dongyuan sacrifices himself to protect Ling Jiushi from an ambush.

videos.title: The Death of Li Dongyuan (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi seeks revenge for Li Dongyuan’s death, discovering X Organization’s deadly motives and reflecting on past games.

videos.title: The Death of Li Dongyuan (2)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi learns of a new X Organization member entering the gate and searches for answers to cryptic clues.

videos.title: Saoqing Niang (1)
videos.overview: Entering the “Saoqing Niang” gate, Ling Jiushi realizes his enemies are disguised, starting a suspenseful journey.

videos.title: Saoqing Niang (2)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu uncover a small path and manipulate rainfall, discovering hidden threats along the way.

videos.title: Saoqing Niang (3)
videos.overview: A magical umbrella provides a safe space as Ling Jiushi navigates dangers, revealing the identity of a would-be assassin.

videos.title: Saoqing Niang (4)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu follow clues at a school, surviving attacks and discovering a hidden message within a water tank.

videos.title: Tan Zaozao (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu attend a film premiere and are invited to Tan Zaozao’s award ceremony, sparking new challenges.

videos.title: Tan Zaozao (2)
videos.overview: At an award ceremony, Ling Jiushi faces tragedy as Tan Zaozao is killed, leaving him a cryptic message to continue the mission.

videos.title: Hako Onna (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi gears up for the complex tenth gate, learning the deadly table game that can turn players into killers.

videos.title: Hako Onna (2)
videos.overview: The team starts the box-filled mansion game with limited knowledge of its deadly rules, discovering a hidden insider.

videos.title: Hako Onna (3)
videos.overview: Misleading clues and the Box Demon’s deceptions test Ling Jiushi’s instincts, prompting the players to cooperate to survive.

videos.title: Hako Onna (4)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi risks his life to save Ruan Lanzhu from Box Demon’s control, showing the cost of protecting friends.

videos.title: Hako Onna (5)
videos.overview: The team uses clues to uncover the Box Demon’s inner agent while dangerous tools and skills complicate the mission.

videos.title: Hako Onna (6)
videos.overview: With the Box Demon’s trunk appearing, Ling Jiushi cracks the safe code, and the team deduces the insider is Tian Guxue.

videos.title: Hako Onna (7)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi identifies Box Demon’s emerging threat and realizes Ruan Lanzhu is trapped, triggering a frantic rescue mission.

videos.title: Hako Onna (8)
videos.overview: Desperation strikes Ling Jiushi as Ruan Lanzhu bids farewell, while the team uncovers missing items linked to the traitor.

videos.title: Hako Onna (9)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi uncovers the second inside agent, Xia Ji, and narrowly avoids a deadly attack thanks to Ruan Lanzhu.

videos.title: Hako Onna (10)
videos.overview: Secrets are revealed as Ruan Lanzhu’s fake death exposes the real traitor, while friends make emotional farewells at Obsidian Villa.

videos.title: Hyakki Yagyo (1)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi uncovers past game drafts and starts forming a bold hypothesis to understand the mysterious game.

videos.title: Hyakki Yagyo (2)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi realizes Ruan Lanzhu may be a game NPC with a fatal mission, prompting him to leave Obsidian in anger.

videos.title: Hyakki Yagyo (3)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi is urged to honor his fallen friend as the final X Organization leaders enter the eleventh gate.

videos.title: Hyakki Yagyo (4)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi revisits his old home within the game, narrowly escaping an ambush with help from Li Dongyuan, and reaches the Obsidian Villa.

videos.title: Hyakki Yagyo (5)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi is repeatedly attacked while searching for Ruan Lanzhu, but timely rescues lead to a critical discovery about the hidden key.

videos.title: Hyakki Yagyo (6)
videos.overview: A tense standoff unfolds as Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu race to find the correct exit before rival Yan Balang tricks them into deadly traps.

videos.title: Hyakki Yagyo (7)
videos.overview: Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu face a bittersweet goodbye as Ruan sacrifices himself in the game, leaving Ling confronted with a reality where their friends don’t recognize him.

videos.title: Hyakki Yagyo (8)
videos.overview: After 30 years of research, Ling Jiushi finally tests his VR invention and reunites emotionally with his old friend Ruan Lanzhu.
